note: The closest match to the stated ICP in this batch on every criterion as written. He owns a construction business and employs salespeople, he removed price himself ('I've wasted millions of dollars. I don't give a about six grand'), health is plainly the neglected area beside a working life he is succeeding at, he self-rates his physique six or seven out of ten and wants ripped rather than rescue, and at 6'0" and 207 lb still training once or twice a week he is nowhere near the excluded profile. He is also the clearest evidence yet for the observation already recorded in icp.json that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion: a ten-year suspected degenerated disc that flares for weeks at a time is the one thing that could make loaded kettlebell work unsuitable, and nothing in the ICP screens for it. On the stated criteria he is a perfect fit and he did not buy — and the reason he gave was neither money nor profile, but ten years of failed attempts.
